mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a more accommodative monetary policy, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns is negative or less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and suppresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 5-day returns is positive in the triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) and declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 4.8%) signals a policy response to economic weakness, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary policy response to labor weakness
failure_condition: The interaction term (UNRATE * FEDFUNDS) has a negative coefficient in a regression of 60-day returns, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is negative over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong housing market activity (HOUST > 2000), consumer confidence and spending increase, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 2000, or the Rank IC between HOUST and 20-day returns is negative in the housing expansion regime.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between INDPRO and 5-day SPX returns is negative or less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the core consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or the Rank IC between CPIAUCSL and 60-day returns is positive in the triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.5%), the tight labor market supports consumer spending and corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5%, or the Rank IC between UNRATE and 20-day returns is negative in the low unemployment regime.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong job growth (PAYEMS > 150000) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) signals a robust labor market, which supports consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (PAYEMS * UNRATE) has a negative coefficient in a regression of 5-day returns, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is negative over any 3-year window.
